facts.claim: Queen Elizabeth (Cunard): Entered service 2010; 90,901 GT; 2070 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 294 m length; Vista class.
MS Queen Elizabeth (QE) is a cruise ship of the Vista class operated by the Cunard Line.
The design is modified compared to earlier ships of the same class, and slightly larger than Queen Victoria, at 92,000 GT.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Cunard; entered service 2010; 92,000 GT; approx. 2,070 guests at double occupancy.
